svg.text: Experience.
From Python developer to solutions architect.
Feb 2024 – Present
Overland Park, KS
Squadron Data, Inc.
Solutions Architect
Zelis · healthcare payments
Led the design and rollout of Snowflake OpenFlow as the
single ingestion platform for HIPAA-regulated PHI: 800+
SQL Server tables, some over a billion rows, with SQL
Server Change Tracking and Snowpipe Streaming.
Building Workday ingestion and event-driven Iceberg
ingestion on AWS.
Securus Technologies (Aventiv)
Architecting a FIPS 140-3, Business Critical Snowflake
platform (Prod, Dev, DR) with Okta SSO and SCIM, AWS
PrivateLink and per-agency row-level isolation. Migrating
VeriTracks from Oracle Exadata to Snowflake.
Snowflake, Inc. · contract, Nov 2025 – Feb 2026
Retired SSIS for a Snowflake customer by migrating to
OpenFlow on SPCS, with Git integration and a monitoring
UI. Set up Cortex Code for the team.
Imperial PFS
dbt medallion models, Airflow ELT, Fivetran CDC from
SQL Server, Azure DevOps CI/CD, Entra ID SSO, masking
and row access policies; supported SOC 1 and SOC 2
audits.
Commerce Bank
Azure Databricks platform: ADLS Gen2, Delta Lake, Unity
Catalog ABAC, Terraform; PySpark pipelines with Auto
Loader and Delta Live Tables.
BMO (Bank of Montreal)
Migrated Hive data from Hortonworks HDP to Cloudera
CDP, rebuilding ACID tables where CDP lacked support.
Jan 2021 – Jun 2022
Bangalore, India
Infosys Limited
Data Engineer
Built pipelines and ETL with Spark, Hive, Hadoop and Sqoop,
and Hive models for warehousing and analytics; tuned
partitions, bucketing and compression.
Jul 2019 – Dec 2020
Hyderabad, India
Vengai Software Solutions
Python Developer
Set up database storage monitoring with alerts before
capacity limits; mapped legacy fields to a new schema in
SQL and prepared data for reporting and predictive models.
